Container.Name: Stremio-Offline
Container.Overview: Unofficial self-hosted web client for Stremio addons. Browse addon catalogs, play or convert compatible media, queue downloads, and keep a local library with artwork, metadata and Jellyfin or Emby connections. [b]After installation[/b] open the WebUI and create the first administrator account. Keep the data folder for upgrades and backups. Hardware transcoding requires adding the render device in Advanced View.
Container.ExtraSearchTerms: stremio self hosted homelab media server jellyfin emby real debrid android tv
Container.Requires: An always-on Docker host is recommended. Hardware conversion requires a compatible render device such as /dev/dri.
Container.Description: Self-hosted Stremio addon client with playback, downloads and a local library.

Config.Name: Web UI Port
Config.Description: Host port for the Stremio Offline web interface.

Config.Name: Data
Config.Description: Accounts, addons, artwork and the application database. Include this folder in backups.

Config.Name: Downloads
Config.Description: Downloaded media and the default local library.

Config.Name: Timezone
Config.Description: IANA timezone used by the server.

Config.Name: User ID
Config.Description: UID that owns and writes the mounted folders.

Config.Name: Group ID
Config.Description: GID that owns and writes the mounted folders.

Config.Name: Fix Permissions
Config.Description: Set to 1 once when the folders need to be chowned to the User ID and Group ID.

Config.Name: Additional Library Roots
Config.Description: Comma-separated container paths for extra libraries. Add the matching paths in Advanced View first.

Config.Name: Allowed Private Addon Hosts
Config.Description: Comma-separated private hosts that addons may access.

Config.Name: Allow All Private-network Addons
Config.Description: Only enable when every addon may reach the private network.
